data.name: KRAST FORGE
data.detailed_description:
KRAST FORGE is a fast, free arcade challenge game from Krabbe Studios.
Each run begins with a draft of rule cards that reshape the arena, the boss pressure, and the way sparks behave. Survive the Forge Core, build a high score, and when you clear a machine, turn that exact run into a challenge other players can attempt.

What makes Krastforge special is the loop between solo play and shared competition. A strong run does not disappear after the score screen; it becomes a route with the same seed, the same card order, and the same pressure for every challenger. That means leaderboards are not only global, they are personal. You are not just chasing a score. You are daring other players to beat the machine you forged.

Features

- Fast arcade score-attack runs with crisp movement and escalating pressure

- Rule-card drafting that twists gravity, sparks, arena behavior, and boss danger

- Shareable challenge runs with exact seeds and fixed card order for challengers

- Global boards and per-challenge rankings

- A customizable Forge profile with skins, banners, frames, badges, and titles

- Quick restarts, readable controls, and a high-replay loop built for one more run

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel /AMD, 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard
